questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the mumbers of the following set.

 

(7,42,299)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number** = First Number x 6.

Third Number = Second number x 7 + 5

(7,42,299)

⇒ 7 × 6 = **42**

⇒ 42 × 7 = **294**
⇒ 294 + **5** = **299**

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) (5, 32, 239)

⇒ 32 x 7 + 5 = 224 + 5 = 229

Option 2) (11, 62, 303)

⇒ 21 × 20 = 420 ≠ 179

Option 3) (3, 22, 159)

⇒ 17 × (17 − 1) = 17 × 16 = **272 ≠ 153**

Option 4) (13, 52, 359)

⇒ (21 × 6) + 6

⇒ 126 + 6 = 132 ≠ 122.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3"

questions.question: Rahul invested an amount of ₹1,50,000 in a private bank at compound interest payable annually. If the rate of interest is 15% p.a., what will be the total interest after two years?
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal = ₹1,50,000
Rate = 15% per year
Time = 2 years

Year 1 interest = 15% of 1,50,000 = ₹22,500
Amount after year 1 = 1,72,500

Year 2 interest = 15% of 1,72,500 = ₹25,875

Total compound interest = 22,500 + 25,875 = **₹48,375**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

 

Venus, Planet, Moon
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Planet and Venus:**

**Venus** is a **Planet**. This means the class **Venus** is entirely a subset of the class **Planet**. (One circle fully inside the other).

**Planet and Moon:**

A **Moon** is a natural satellite, not a planet.

The class **Moon** is entirely separate from the class **Planet**. (Two circles separate from each other).

**Venus and Moon:**

**Venus** is a specific object (a planet), and **Moon** is a class of objects (satellites).

They are distinct and separate entities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2766ca6b79f251e9d5382b6f8fe8d3c9062daeb84b94c4c0334b717fb84aaf65.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the below statements disregarding commonly known facts, and then from the given four options, identify the Venn diagram that correctly represents the statements.

 

Statements:

 

1) No Pentagon (P) is a Hyperbola (H).

2) All Hyperbolas (H) are Quadrilaterals (Q).
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**No Pentagon (P) is a Hyperbola (H):**

This means the circle representing **Pentagons (P)** and the circle representing **Hyperbolas (H)** must be **separate** with no intersection.

**All Hyperbolas (H) are Quadrilaterals (Q):**

This means the circle representing **Hyperbolas (H)** must be entirely **contained within** the circle representing **Quadrilaterals (Q)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05fb500b9eb0569460ed21bef66930f68a489d4e70be1878ac2b614ce3200e62.png] 

So,** Figure**** 1** is the only diagram that satisfies both the condition of **no overlap between P and H** and the condition of **H being completely contained within Q**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

 

18 - 2 x 7 ÷ 6 + 10 = 67
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 18 - 2 x 7 ÷ 6 + 10 = 67

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 18 ÷ 2 × 7 − 6 + 10

⇒ 9 × 7 − 6 + 10

⇒ 63 − 6 + 10

⇒ 57 + 10 =** 67.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
